blocks.text: Istima Privacy Policy
Last Updated: October 2026

This Privacy Policy explains what Istima by Halalweb ('we', 'us', 'our') collects and does with your information when you use the Istima Qur'an app and website (together, 'the App'). We keep data collection small on purpose.
By using the App you agree to this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
1. Information We Collect
1.1 Stored on your device
The App keeps this data on your device. Unless you create an account (section 1.2), it does not leave your device:
Favorite reciters, loved surahs, playlists and your listening history
App settings (theme, reading mode, Mushaf display, playback speed, sleep timer, translation and tafsir choices, language)
Downloaded audio for offline listening
Mushaf reading position, verse notes and highlights
Adhkar and tasbeeh counters and saved adhkar
You can remove this data by clearing the App's storage in your device or browser settings, or by uninstalling the App.
1.2 Istima account (optional)
You can use the App without an account. If you create one, we collect:
Your email address, a name you choose, and a password. The password is stored only as a salted hash (PBKDF2), never in readable form.
A sign-in session token. On iOS and Android it is kept in the operating system's secure storage. On the web it is kept in your browser.

While you are signed in, these items are synced to our servers so they match across your devices: app settings, favorite reciters, play counts, playlists, verse notes and annotations, saved adhkar, your reading position, your library and your listening goals. Your interface language is not synced. Downloaded audio is never synced.
We do not send verification emails or marketing emails. There is currently no password reset by email.
1.3 Shared playlists

If you choose to share a playlist or a list of tracks, the App sends its title and its list of recitations to our servers and creates a link. Anyone who has the link can open that list. Shared lists do not include your name or email address.
1.4 Analytics and crash reports

The App's code includes optional support for anonymous usage analytics and crash reports, but the Istima web app is built without any analytics or crash reporting keys, so it sends none. We do not use advertising networks, social media trackers or cross-app tracking. If we turn analytics or crash reporting on in a future version, we will update this policy first.
1.5 Notifications

If you turn on the daily verse notification, the App asks your device for permission to show notifications. The reminder is scheduled on your device. It does not use a push server and no information about it is sent to us. You can turn it off in the App or in your device settings at any time.
1.6 Qur'an content
Qur'an text, translations and tafsir are bundled with the App or loaded from the App's own site. Downloading them does not send personal information to anyone.
2. How We Use Information
Local data powers the App: restoring your settings, offline listening, resuming playback.
Account data is used only to sign you in and keep your synced data the same across your devices. It is not used for advertising or sold.
Shared playlist data is used only to show the shared list to people who open the link.
3. Sharing and Disclosure
We do not sell or rent your personal information, and we do not share it for advertising.
3.1 Service providers and sources
Cloudflare: hosts the App's website and our account and sync service (Cloudflare Workers and D1 database). It processes your requests and stores account and synced data on our behalf.

MP3Quran.com and other audio hosts: recitation audio is streamed directly from these servers. Your device contacts them when you play audio, so they can see your device's IP address and which file is requested, as with any web request.
App stores (Apple App Store and Google Play): provide the downloads and may collect their own data under their policies.
4. Data Security
Network traffic uses HTTPS.
Passwords are hashed and salted and cannot be read by us.
Session tokens are stored in the operating system's secure storage on iOS and Android.
No system is perfectly secure, so we cannot promise absolute security.
5. Children's Privacy

The App is suitable for all ages. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without a parent's consent. If you believe a child has created an account, contact us and we will delete it.
6. Your Rights and Choices
Use the App without an account.
Delete your account in the App (Settings, Account). This removes the account and its synced data from our servers.
Clear local data by clearing the App's storage or uninstalling the App.
Turn notifications off in the App or in your device settings.
Ask us to access, correct or delete your data by emailing us.
For EU Residents (GDPR)
If you are in the European Economic Area you have the right to access, correct or delete your data, and to object to or restrict processing. Contact us at the address below.
For California Residents (CCPA)
California residents have the right to know what data we collect and to ask for its deletion. We do not sell personal information.
7. International Data Transfers
Cloudflare runs a global network, so your data may be processed in countries other than your own. By using the App you accept these transfers.
8. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this policy. We will change the 'Last Updated' date above and tell you about material changes in the App. Continued use after a change means you accept the updated policy.
9. Contact Us
Questions about this policy: app@istima.app
